note: The M12 compile-performance stack (2026-09-30): 66 hunks of ~/.cache/btrc/m12/full.diff in fifteen commits. Hunks of the generated stdlib symbol table are left out and regenerated after the commits listed in regenerate_after.

commits.title: Skip the full node index for type-node misses
commits.body:
A type node the type index lacks is in no declaration: the full index
holds it at the same position. Navigation g-transitive 0.85 s -> 0.79 s,
UI c-declarations 0.43 s -> 0.34 s at --jobs 1.

commits.title: Build type identity keys in one string builder
commits.body:
Replayed instance facts encode a key each; appending into one builder
replaces a concatenation per field. g-transitive 0.50 s -> 0.33 s on every
edit fixture; navigation 106.9 G -> 102.7 G instructions.

commits.title: Scan split delimiters with strcspn
commits.body:
Only a candidate first byte is compared in full, instead of a strncmp
call per byte. Record parsing and replay split every stored line.

commits.title: Stream group source lines into their digest
commits.body:
The same digest as of the joined line, without building one string per
line.

commits.title: Resolve each output directory once per validation pass
commits.body:
A generation's outputs share a few directories; outputPath resolved the
same parent once per output on every validation.

commits.title: Ask the package policy only about referenced owners
commits.body:
Visibility asked the import policy about every reachable file of every
source; it now asks about owners a reference names, once per source.
visibility 0.32 s -> 0.26 s.

commits.title: Scan Bytes eight ASCII bytes at a time
Publish an edit without reading unchanged outputs twice
commits.body:
Retention verifies the committed manifest after every output, so a
manifest that already differs skips it; kept outputs are revalidated by
the revision their bytes were verified at, as retention does.
Navigation 99.9 G -> 98.7 G.

commits.title: Reference stored module units from a stored generation
commits.body:
A generation's manifest (schema 2) names the module-unit identity of
each unit the store already holds instead of copying its text: an edit
wrote 71 MB of parts, now only the primary, runtime unit and link plan.
A referenced unit is read under its own lease and must have the listed
digest. No-op compile 1.40 s -> 1.44 s.

commits.title: Share only signatures of foreign constructors and destructors
commits.body:
The declarations-only lowering built every class's initializers,
allocator cleanup and field releases, and every instance's, then kept
only prototypes. A body another group defines is lowered by that group's
unit. Emitted units are byte-identical; l-declarations 0.73 s -> 0.58 s,
navigation 98.0 G -> 94.8 G, peak 1.06 -> 0.98 GiB.

commits.title: Digest source content with the host's SHA-256
commits.body:
The macOS entry's accelerated provider now also names source content
and the artifact identity. r-graph 0.49 s -> 0.43 s.

commits.title: Claim declaration symbols once per program
commits.body:
The completed pass repeated every declaration's generated-symbol claims;
it now starts from the first pass's and claims generic instances only.

commits.title: Resolve the Python compiler API on first use
commits.body:
tools.native_plan imports two leaf modules; the package init loaded the
whole compiler first. Import 0.20 s -> 0.05 s.

commits.title: Validate deferred objects beside debug retention and link expansion
commits.body:
The deferred units' second reader session, the debug-object inventory
and the link command's driver expansion no longer wait on each other.

commits.title: Share verified debug-object identities with the link receipt
commits.body:
Retention hashes every retained object; the link context read them all
again. Link context 0.10 s -> 0.05 s.
